ExecutionOnly.name: Execution Only
ExecutionOnly.definition: Specifies to whom the product can be sold on an execution-only basis. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 06010.

ExecutionWithAppropriatenessTestOrNonAdv.name: Execution With Appropriateness Test Or Non Advised Services
ExecutionWithAppropriatenessTestOrNonAdv.definition: Specifies to whom the product can be sold with an appropriateness test or to a non-advised service. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 06020.

InvestmentAdvice.name: Investment Advice
InvestmentAdvice.definition: Specifies to whom the product can be sold if investment advice has been provided. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 06030.

PortfolioManagement.name: Portfolio Management
PortfolioManagement.definition: Specifies to whom the product can be sold if portfolio management has been provided. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 06040.
